_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Sign-up and account: 1. Register a new venue: the last step is now Start free trial. The 14 days start at once and the app asks for no card or payment. 2. More > Delete my Vesopa account explains what it removes, then opens Vesopa's account deletion page. 3. On iPhone, Tap to Pay on iPhone is not offered until Apple switches it on for Vesopa Go: the card button goes to the card machine, with QR Pay beside it. Android is unchanged.
release_notes: Start your free trial straight from the app, with nothing to pay up front, and delete your Vesopa account from More whenever you want to.
